maddeler.e:
يتلاوم (form VI)
# يَتَلَاوَمُ (yatalāwamu) /ja.ta.laː.wa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
# يَتَلَاوَمَ (yatalāwama) /ja.ta.laː.wa.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
# يَتَلَاوَمْ (yatalāwam) /ja.ta.laː.wam/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَلَاوَمَ (talāwama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
